description: Na₄Al₃(GeO₄)₃BH₄ crystallizes in the cubic P̅43n space group. The structure consists of two BH₄ clusters inside a Na₄Al₃(GeO₄)₃ framework. In each BH₄ cluster, B is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent H atoms. All B-H bond lengths are 1.23 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one B atom. In the Na₄Al₃(GeO₄)₃ framework, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.35 Å. Al is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. All Al-O bond lengths are 1.77 Å. Ge is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. All Ge-O bond lengths are 1.76 Å. O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Ge atom.
